name: Trade License Check
description:
SBO.06. Use this tool only when TRADE_LICENSE_CHECK does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG in existing_runtime_results. It is the first
mandatory tool of a new assessment.

It checks the Trade License and Establishment Card: licence validity and
expiry, business name match, and verification through the DUL API (QR
code or the government portal via UAE Pass as fallbacks). Stop if it
returns is_terminal=true.

name: Identity Validation
description:
SBO.07. Use this tool only when IDENTITY_VALIDATION does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG and the Trade License check has passed.

It cross-checks the Emirates ID with the Establishment Card / Trade
License names and the request. It establishes who the person is.

name: POA/MOA Check
description:
Use this tool only when POA_MOA_CHECK does not already have PASS or
PASS_WITH_FLAG and identity has passed.

A Power of Attorney or Memorandum of Association is required only when
the representative is not recorded as owner, manager with representative
authority or authorised signatory whose capacity covers the requested
actions. A recorded limitation goes to a specialist.
If the document is missing the tool asks the customer for it.

name: Bad Debt Check
description:
SBO.09 (with SBO.08 duplicate-PD cross-check). Use this tool only when
BAD_DEBT_CHECK is the first incomplete mandatory check and the POA/MOA
check has passed.

It verifies bad debt and blue-collar behaviour for every party linked to
the licence or the person.

name: AVCV Verification
description:
SBO.10. Use this tool only when AVCV_VERIFICATION is the first incomplete
mandatory check and every earlier mandatory check has passed.

It runs Address Verification and Credit Verification. Only an adverse
result is a rejection; unable-to-verify, refer and discrepancy go to a
specialist, and insufficient information asks for proof of address.
